t.en: Each extra atom doubles the rows of a truth table. The prover’s new module, the <wiki-ref to="kernel"></wiki-ref>, works another way: from premises to a conclusion, one <wiki-ref to="rule"></wiki-ref> at a time.
The givens on the left are the premises; the goal on the right is the proposition to prove. A wire carries a sentence already proved.
The tests below put different sentences in place of the letters of one pattern, the last being the letters themselves. One board must pass them all.

hint.en: A given’s dot is on its right; the goal’s dot is on its left.
